title: Crack the Losers’ Code
dek: Every letter has been swapped for another. Three are done for you. The answer is the whole point of this magazine, which is a hint.
summary: A letter-substitution cryptogram whose two-sentence answer sums up the magazine’s theme: who keeps the files decides how history remembers losers.
